field.label: GPS type
field.help:
This option allows you to select a predefined configuration.
Note: Select Generic if your GPS is not listed.
Note: The predefined configurations assume your GPS has already been set to NMEA mode.

field.label: Serial port
field.help: All serial ports are listed - be sure to pick the port with the GPS attached.

field.label: Baud rate
field.help:
Serial port baud rate.
Note: A higher baud rate is generally only helpful if the GPS is sending too many sentences. It is recommended to configure the GPS to send only one sentence at a baud rate of 4800 or 9600.

field.label: NMEA sentences
field.help: By default NTP will listen for all supported NMEA sentences. Select one or more specific sentences to restrict which ones NTP will use.

field.label: Fudge time 1
field.help: Fudge time 1 is used to specify the GPS PPS signal offset in seconds (default: 0.0).

field.label: Fudge time 2
field.help: Fudge time 2 is used to specify the serial end of line time offset in seconds (default: 0.0).

field.label: Stratum
field.help:
(0-15)
This may be used to change the GPS Clock stratum (default: 0). This may be useful if, for some reason, you want ntpd to prefer a different clock.

field.label: Clock ID
field.help:
(1 to 4 characters)
This may be used to change the GPS Clock ID (default: GPS).

field.label: Prefer this clock
field.help: NTP should prefer this clock (default: enabled).

field.label: Do not use this clock
field.help: NTP should not use this clock. It will be displayed for reference only (default: disabled).

field.label: Enable PPS signal processing
field.help: Default: disabled. The GPS type presets enable it.

field.label: Enable falling edge PPS signal processing
Enable kernel PPS clock discipline
field.help: Default: disabled. The GPS type presets enable it.

field.label: Log sub-second fraction of received timestamp
GPS initialization commands
field.help: Commands entered here will be sent to the GPS during initialization. Please read and understand your GPS documentation before making any changes here.
